source_type: Official Royal University of Phnom Penh Graduate School of Science scholarship announcement
funding_classification_basis: RUPP announces 10 PhD Physics positions for academic year 2026-2027, including 4 full scholarships supported by HEIP-2. Recurring living-cost support is not established, so EduPath classifies the award as Partially Funded rather than Fully Funded.
notes: The scholarship announcement was published on 2 July 2026 and asks interested applicants to apply before 11 September 2026. The record is therefore open on the 23 August 2026 verification date.

source_type: Official Institute of Technology of Cambodia International Engineering Program 2026 page
funding_classification_basis: The official ITC International Engineering Program 2026 page lists 65 Techo Digital Talent Scholarships at 100% for Artificial Intelligence Engineering and Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and Aerospace and Autonomous Systems Engineering. The source does not establish a recurring living-cost package, so the record is classified as Partially Funded.
notes: ITC's International Engineering Program accepts a high-school diploma or equivalent and requires an English qualification plus an entrance examination. The explicit published application period is 31 August through 22 September 2026. Although the same page contains a generic 'Application now Open' label, the more precise dated application period is used for structured status; therefore the award is marked upcoming on 23 August 2026.
